notes:
Yealink MeetingBar A20 is an all-in-one Android video collaboration bar (camera + 8-mic MEMS array + speaker + compute + Wi-Fi/Bluetooth) for small-to-medium rooms; sold as base endpoint (A20-010) or bundled with CTP18 touch panel / VCH51 sharing kit / WPP30 wireless presentation pod (A20-020/021/025). Not rack-mountable (wall/TV-mount or desktop; 600x68x82mm), so rackUnits omitted.

Port names/layout were confirmed visually from the rear-panel diagram in Yealink's own Quick Start Guide (silkscreen labels: Reset, DC48V, HDMI 1, VC Hub/Phone, Internet, HDMI 2, plus a side-panel USB-A + Kensington lock slot) — Reset pinhole and the security-lock slot are not signal/power connectors so were excluded.

Both HDMI ports are OUTPUTS only (confirmed by datasheet's "2 x HDMI output (CEC supported)" and the port diagram) — the unit has no native HDMI input; a second-source/content-sharing input is only available via the optional external VCH51 Sharing Kit box (its own HDMI/USB-C in), which connects to the A20 through the "VC Hub/Phone" RJ45 port, so no HDMI-input port is listed for the A20 itself. No HDMI version (1.4/2.0/2.1) is stated anywhere in the datasheet or manuals, so grade was omitted for both HDMI ports (the camera is separately described as supporting "4K video output," but that describes capture/processing, not a confirmed HDMI link version). The "VC Hub/Phone" RJ45 port is a proprietary Yealink interface, not standard Ethernet, so it was left without an eth- grade.

Direct WebFetch access to yealink.com and to B&H/Sweetwater/Markertek product pages returned HTTP 403 (bot protection) throughout this session, and B&H/Sweetwater no longer stock the standalone A20 ("No Longer Available"). Specs were instead verified from Yealink's own official PDF documents — "MeetingBar A20 Datasheet" and the "MeetingBar A20 ... Quick Start Guide (V1.3)" (both carry Yealink letterhead/branding and match the filenames referenced on support.yealink.com) — as mirrored by distributor ipphone-warehouse.com, and cross-checked against a manualslib.com excerpt referencing "HDMI 1 port."

ports.name: VC Hub/Phone
ports.note: Proprietary Yealink VCH interface (not standard Ethernet) used to attach the optional VCH51 Sharing Kit, which adds an HDMI/USB-C content-sharing input; also used for VCR20/CTP18 style hub accessories.

ports.name: DC48V
ports.note: Power input jack fed by the included external adapter: AC 100-240V in, DC 48V/0.7A out.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Also delivers 5V/0.5A output power to attached accessories such as the WPP20/WPP30 wireless presentation pod dongle.
